page_title: BAR 3-0 RAY | Barcelona v Rayo Vallecano 19/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
90+2' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' Jesus Gil Manzano has a clear sight and sees a foul from Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano).
88' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
85' The total number of attempts is 14:14.
82' Vitor Roque (Barcelona) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles past the right post.
79' It's time for a substitution. Vitor Roque (Barcelona) comes on in place of Robert Lewandowski.
79' A substitution has been made. Isi Palazon goes off and Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) comes on.
79' Inigo Perez decides to make a substitution. Sergio Camello will be replaced by Radamel Falcao (Rayo Vallecano).
79' The attendance for today's match is 35823.
78' It looks like Andreas Christensen (Barcelona) saw red with that tackle. Jesus Gil Manzano won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
76' Alvaro Garcia goes off the pitch and Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) comes on.
75' 3 - 0 Pedri (Barcelona) receives a well-taken defence-splitting low pass inside the box and scores! His great effort makes its way into the middle of the goal.
75' The cross fools the defence and leaves Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) with an easy chance inside the box, but he mistimes his shot and sends it just wide of the right post.

72' 2 - 0 The goalkeeper makes a save but the ball rebounds off him out to Pedri (Barcelona). He finds himself some space inside the penalty area and unleashes an unstoppable shot which bounces in off the crossbar. A magnificent goal!

72' Joao Felix (Barcelona) produced a promising shot low towards the middle of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Stole Dimitrievski thwarted him with a fabulous save and the score remains the same.
71' Joao Felix (Barcelona) collects a wonderful lead pass and creates some space to smash the ball goalwards from long range. His shot goes painfully wide of the left post!

70' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the left post. Marc-Andre ter Stegen is alert and denies him with a nice save.
68' Pedri (Barcelona) was too forceful with his tackle and Jesus Gil Manzano interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
67' What a miskick by Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano). He smashes a volley from long distance that goes into the stands.
67' The resulting corner from Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is cleared by the defence.
66' Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Rayo Vallecano will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
62' Xavi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Pedri (Barcelona) replacing Fermin Lopez.
62' Substitution. Raphinha makes his way off the pitch and Joao Felix (Barcelona) comes on as his replacement.
62' Here is a change. Pau Cubarsi is going off and Xavi gives the last tactical orders to Ronald Araujo (Barcelona).
62' Oscar Valentin comes off the pitch to be replaced by Miguel Crespo (Rayo Vallecano).
62' The substitution has been made. Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) has replaced Jorge de Frutos.
61' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) fires a powerful shot which is blocked.
61' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) takes the corner but it's cleared.
59' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His effort towards the roof of the net is saved by Stole Dimitrievski. Barcelona have a corner.
59' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
58' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee blows his whistle, Barcelona are awarded a corner kick.

57' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Marc-Andre ter Stegen makes a great save.

56' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
54' One of the players from Rayo Vallecano times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
53' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) commits a foul and Jesus Gil Manzano immediately signals a free kick.
52' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
52' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
50' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) has tested the patience of referee Jesus Gil Manzano and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
50' Rayo Vallecano are ruled offside.
49' Andreas Christensen (Barcelona) commits a rough challenge and Jesus Gil Manzano blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Xavi makes a half-time substitution. Andreas Christensen comes on in place of Sergi Roberto (Barcelona).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+1' Jesus Gil Manzano has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) didn't manage to convert the resulting corner kick into a goal. He produced a header from a dangerous position inside the box, but he sent it well over the bar.
45' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is about to take a corner kick.
43' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) leaps highest in the middle of the box to meet a lofted ball and powers a header at a goal, but unfortunately for him it flies just over the bar.
42' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) sends a long ball in, but Stole Dimitrievski comfortably gathers the ball.
41' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) but poses no threat. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
39' The corner by Raphinha (Barcelona) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
39' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. It will be a corner kick for Barcelona.
38' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) misses a great opportunity to convert the free kick from the edge of the penalty box after firing the ball high over the crossbar of the goal.
37' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) was quite harsh and Jesus Gil Manzano didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
36' Good play from Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) gives him some space for the shot from distance, but it's lacking accuracy and goes well wide of the left post.
34' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
32' Stole Dimitrievski reacts well to deny a long-range free kick from Raphinha (Barcelona) towards the top right corner.
31' Raphinha (Barcelona) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
31' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) commits a rough foul. Jesus Gil Manzano stops the game and makes a call. Barcelona earn a free kick.
29' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Barcelona.

29' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play and Barcelona manage to earn a corner.
28' Raphinha (Barcelona) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
27' Dangerous play by Fermin Lopez (Barcelona). Jesus Gil Manzano blows his whistle for a foul.
26' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Stole Dimitrievski comes off the line to clear the ball away.
25' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and has an effort on goal. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies inches high over the bar.
23' Abdul Mumin (Rayo Vallecano) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jesus Gil Manzano had an easy-decision to make.
22' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
20' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.

18' That's unlucky! Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) side steps a tackle after receiving a pass, advances then hits a booming shot from mid-range which only rises at the last second to fly just over the bar.

16' A rebound falls to Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) who knows what to do with it. He drills a low shot from the edge of the penalty box, but Marc-Andre ter Stegen anticipates his intention and denies him with a nice quick save.
16' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
16' Abdul Mumin (Rayo Vallecano) takes a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but his effort is well blocked by the defender. Rayo Vallecano will take a corner kick.
16' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

15' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Rayo Vallecano will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
15' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) takes the corner.
14' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Barcelona comes to nothing.
14' Barcelona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. The linesman makes the right call and Barcelona will have a corner.
14' The free kick is taken by Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona), but ball is cleared. Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick.
13' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
10' Jesus Gil Manzano shows a yellow card to Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) for his blatant foul.
9' The corner is swung in but Barcelona can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
7' Marc-Andre ter Stegen makes a save to deny the long-range effort from Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) towards the middle of the goal.
6' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) creates himself some space in front of goal and connects with the resulting free kick. His header is badly mistimed and sails high over the bar.
6' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) will take the free kick.
5' Jesus Gil Manzano blows his whistle for a foul after Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) hacks down one of his opponents. A free kick to Rayo Vallecano.
4' The cross into the penalty area from Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
3' 1 - 0 Goal! Lamine Yamal puts a cross into the box and finds Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona), who latches on to it and strikes the ball inside the left post. He makes it 1:0.
